name: London Eye (Large)
description: The prototype of the Romantic Ferris Wheel is the London Eye, which is an upgraded version of the classic Happy Ferris Wheel. The London Eye is located on the banks of the Thames River and was built by the United Kingdom to celebrate the year 2000. The Ferris wheel is 135 meters high and was once the tallest in the world. Sitting on it, you can overlook the whole of London. It is said that lovers who kiss at the highest point of the Ferris wheel can achieve lasting happiness. Therefore, the Ferris wheel has its own romantic atmosphere, and it also carries every couple to overlook the complicated world together in the dreamy starry night.
